register: Student task statements an analyst read into executable arithmetic. Each row names one lesson span, quotes the text it read the operands from, and cites where that text stands: a physical line in the tracked teacher-guide markdown, or a lesson-and-position key in the recovered-expressions sidecar. A row that names the value the guide prints for the item carries a second, independent witness; a row whose witness disagrees with the automaton is refused, never corrected.
